item.title: German Rheinmetall open-sources its Battlesuite connected weapon system protcol
item.description:
📝 It provides a standardized data model that ensures interoperability across complex hardware and software environments. Built on the ddkit software development kit, this library utilizes the Data Distribution Service (DDS) standard by the Object Management Group (OMG). This data-centric publish-subscribe architecture guarantees reliable, low-latency data exchange for high-demand applications.
